import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long stmod(long a, long b, long p) {
        if (b == 0) {
            return 1;
        } else {
            if (b % 2 == 0) {
                long x = stmod(a, b / 2, p);
                return (x * x) % p;
            } else {
                long x = stmod(a, b - 1, p);
                return (x * a) % p;
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long p = sc.nextLong();
        long k = sc.nextLong();

        long pcon = 1000000007;
        long[] obr = new long[1000005];

        obr[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i < 1000003; i++) {
            long a = pcon / i;
            long b = pcon % i;
            long c = (a * (pcon - obr[(int) b])) % pcon;
            obr[i] = c;
        }

        long ans;
        if (k == 0) {
            ans = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < p - 1; i++) {
                ans = (ans * p) % pcon;
            }
        } else {
            long io = 1;
            int lk = 0;
            int jj = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i < p; i++) {
                io = (io * k) % p;
                if ((io % p) == 1) {
                    if (lk == 0) {
                        jj = i;
                        lk = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
            ans = 1;
            long pr = 1;
            long t = (p - 1) / jj;
            if (k == 1) {
                ans = 1;
                for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
                    ans = (ans * p) % pcon;
                }
            } else {
                for (long i = 1; i <= t; i++) {
                    pr = (pr * obr[(int) i]) % pcon;
                    pr = (pr * (t - i + 1)) % pcon;
                    pr = (pr * t) % pcon;
                    pr = (pr * jj) % pcon;
                    ans = (ans + pr) % pcon;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
